import json, pathlib, re
F = pathlib.Path('tests/fixtures/evidence-2a')
DENY = re.compile('/Users/|/home/|/private/var/|/var/folders/|@gmail[.]com|(?<![A-Za-z0-9_-])sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16}|ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{20}|github_pat_|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|xox[abp]-|-----BEGIN')
m = json.loads((F / 'MANIFEST.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert m['placeholder'] == '@PURRFECT_ROOT@' and m['mission'] == 'docs/missions/20261014-2a-foundation', m
runs = m['runs']; ids = [r['run_id'] for r in runs]
assert 6 <= len(runs) <= 10 and len(set(ids)) == len(ids), ids
acc = {r['run_id'] for r in runs if r['accepted']}
assert acc == {'35ecb39a-5c22-4108-acef-41f7fc694ad6', 'fdf5dd38-1433-45eb-972b-823493f9e671', '02e9c769-5c85-4204-9d8e-9933f8c3f819'}, acc
assert 'f87755da-6925-41a0-80e8-bf7ee4d78002' in ids and any(r['role'] == 'brain' for r in runs)
assert {'codex', 'claude', 'agent'} <= {r['provider'] for r in runs} and 9 in {r['contract'] for r in runs} and len({r['contract'] for r in runs}) >= 3
assert any(r['argv_form'] == 'historical-pre-T-071' for r in runs)
files = [p for p in F.rglob('*') if p.is_file()]
assert not any('.tasks' in p.parts or p.suffix == '.log' for p in files)
for p in files:
    assert not DENY.search(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')), p
feats = json.loads((F / 'features.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['features']
assert {f['accepted_run_id'] for f in feats} == acc
for r in runs:
    i = r['run_id']
    s = json.loads((F / 'specs' / (i + '.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    rc = json.loads((F / 'receipts' / (i + '.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    a = json.loads((F / 'argv' / (i + '.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    assert s['repo'] == rc['repo'] == '@PURRFECT_ROOT@' and rc['execution_spec_path'] == '@PURRFECT_ROOT@/.tasks/specs/' + i + '.json', i
    assert (s['provider'], s['role'], s.get('provider_contract_version', 1)) == (r['provider'], r['role'], r['contract']) == (rc['provider'], rc['role'], r['contract']), i
    assert a[0] == rc['resolved_configuration']['executable'] and r['argv_form'] in ('current', 'historical-pre-T-071'), i
    assert (F / 'verification' / r['accepted_record']).is_file() if r['accepted'] else r.get('accepted_record') is None, i
print('ok')
grep -qxF '          fetch-depth: 0' .github/workflows/ci.yml && grep -qxF '        run: python3 tests/test-evidence-2a.py' .github/workflows/ci.yml
git ls-files -z '*.json' | xargs -0 -n 1 sh -c 'python3 -m json.tool "$1" >/dev/null' sh
